responses.text: Sharing knowledge with an outsider organization. I knew Veronica couldn't be trusted.
We tracked your movements a long way. But it was worth it to catch her in the act.
Passing Brotherhood secrets to outsiders is the lowest form of treason. What have you got to say for yourself?
We heard Veronica talking with the Elder. We won't stand for this.
What is this? Veronica brings an outsider into our home, then has a private audience with the Elder?
The two of you may have the Elder fooled, but we know better.
Veronica has always twisted the Founder's principles to her own ends. We will not stand idly by and allow her to corrupt our Elder's thinking.
Leaving? Into exile? Good. Save us the trouble.
But mark me well. Any hint of treachery or thought of return and we will erase the both of you from existence.

topics.prompt: It won't be a problem. She's leaving.

responses.text: Respect, nothing. She plans to whisper in his ear. Poison him against the Codex.

topics.prompt: Won't stand for what? She plans to respect the Elder's decision.

responses.text: A paladin always has a say where the Codex is concerned. Veronica's aspirations are seditious.
All of us here are sworn to obey and protect the Codex, even against one of our own. She's gone too far this time.
No... this has to end now.
Execute them.

topics.prompt: You don't have a say. Go back in your cave.

responses.text: Hmmph. She'd be doing a greater service by carrying out her duties and not trying to undermine the elder's authority.
This had better be the last time her loyalty falters. You've been warned.

topics.prompt: Ideals are strengthened by the challenges they endure. Veronica's questioning did you a service.

responses.text: You're pathetic. Hide behind words all you like, but your cowardice shows through.

topics.prompt: Uh... Veronica just said those things to test you. She didn't mean it.

responses.text: Their sentimentality prevents them from administering justice.
Our duty is to the Codex above all, something your companion has forgotten. And that gives us the authority to {emph} make it our place.

topics.prompt: This isn't your place. You're neither Head Scribe nor Elder.

responses.text: {Fearful} No. No!

topics.prompt: I will cast down your Codex and bask in the dying agony of those who hold it dear.

responses.text: High Elder Maxson didn't just found the Brotherhood. He defined it. To serve in the Brotherhood is to serve his ideals.
Our way of life is based on them. We know no other path. There {emph} is no other path.
With her... leanings... Veronica spits in the face of every Knight, Paladin, and Scribe to serve in our ranks.

topics.prompt: I don't get what the big deal is.

responses.text: That doesn't matter in the slightest. You are an accessory to treason simply by association.
In the name of the Elder, I hereby sentence you to death.
She has made her intentions plain. We will not risk any further damage.

topics.prompt: She hasn't shared any secrets. You don't have any proof otherwise.

responses.text: Did you just-? How dare you belch in the face of a Paladin of the Brotherhood of Steel?!
{Insulted} No, I don't wear it on{...dates} - Enough.

topics.prompt: Your face must be pretty ugly to always be wearing that helmet. Do you wear it on dates, too?
